Ivy: Quick note from support: function-calling guide still shows `response_schema` + `callTool()` in one example. Can someone update to v1 and add a tiny migration note?
Rahul: I can swap to `invokeTool()` and add JS + Python snippets.
Bea: I'll handle the JSON schema. Recommend we show the strict canonical example only and a one-line lenient note.
Ivy: yes, strict canonical and migration blurb: `response_schema -> outputSchema`, `callTool -> invokeTool`.
Rahul: Proposed JS snippet:
```js
// v1
const r = await client.invokeTool('summarize', { input: text, params: { temperature: 0 } });
console.log(r.output);
```
Bea: Canonical schema to paste:
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {"summary": {"type":"string"}},
  "required": ["summary"],
  "additionalProperties": false
}
```
Rahul: add tiny parse+validate example and a one-line caching warning linking to caching guide.
Ivy: I'll add changelog bullet and request preview.
Docs Bot: scheduled: docs/link-check and docs/schema-lint on the branch.
PreviewBot: preview URL queued: https://preview.docs.redwood.ai/pr-615/ (48h)
Ivy: merging once CI is green.
